text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, we passed by
the park where the neighborhood bully used to hang out...
but she was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's not here today either, is she?
I haven't seen her around lately at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I do worry whether she's bedridden from overeating,
or if she pulled a muscle practicing Precure
transformation scenes...

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text: ...If you mean the boss, they aren't coming anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text: —Because I'm moving away.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? M-Moving!?
I haven't heard anything about this, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text:
I think so too... She told her other
friends not to come see her off either...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —I simply cannot accept such a thing!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter how painful it is, leaving without
a proper farewell... isn't like a princess at all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me!
Where is that child's house!?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text:
W-We're not gonna make it in time!
They said they're leaving this evening—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if she's already left...
As a princess, I will definitely catch up to her!

Though I rushed to the house the child told me about,
...the car had already left.

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... No good, I was too slow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"—No! We made it in time!
I saw a familiar baseball cap
in the back seat of that car driving away!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A mere car is a piece of cake for the Princess!
Oryaaaaaaaah!!

Kawakami Princess dashed forward at full speed,
rapidly catching up to the car—!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, please waaaaaiiiiit!!
For meeeeeeeeeeee!!

—After matching its speed perfectly and appealing furiously alongside it,
the car finally came to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
――I understand. You felt lonely, didn't you?
Being apart from you is just as painful for me, after all...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Still! Just vanishing without even saying a proper goodbye is simply running away from an unpleasant reality!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is not befitting of a princess!
If you run away here, what will you do once you move?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: Sis...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Even a princess must sometimes face painful,
unwanted, and sorrowful realities.
Just like today—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we'll charge in with all our might and carve a path!
That's what the princess spirit is all about!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
――One thing! Please make a promise to me.
That wherever you move to, you will face
every hardship with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That won't be a problem at all! I'm sure
you'll make tons of new friends again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff*...!
Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If you ever feel like giving up anyway—
just watch our races on TV.
I'll remind you what a true princess looks like!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll watch... I'll definitely watch!
Big Sis... we will...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: We'll always be friendsâforever and everâ!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What?! We are besties, Pre-pals, bosom friends!
—And so, the car drove away. Watching it leave, Kawakami Princess had a gentle expression on her face—

—For a brief moment, it showed on the face of Precure,
who proudly continues to fight to protect the peace.
choice_data_list: ...I gotta put on a good showing for her sake too.
...We gotta put on a good showing for her sake too, right?
Maybe the day will come when we run together, heh.
Maybe the day will come when we run together, you know?
We need someone to succeed the gaki daisho...
We need someone to succeed the gaki daisho, don't we...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
After all, we made a princess's promise!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure that she'll do her best in her new home, with the princess's pledge kept close to her heart!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Working hard so as not to lose to friends is a princess's duty too!
From now on, I'll be charging ahead even more full-throttle~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
!? Now that is the absolute best development...!
My blood is boiling with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? But if that's the case, how many years
will I have to keep running as an active racer—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Well! If I stay active for 100 years,
there's no problem whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "For that reason as well... please take good care of me for a long time to come, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Y-Yes.
Indeed, even the world of children needs someone to keep them in line.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She's great at playing, and she's really strong too~
...Wait, huh? Oh my?
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you the best fit for it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
............
N-No, I don't want that at all~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "B-Because... I've already graduated from being a bullyyyyy!!"
